column1: # catalog/release-model.tsv — BH-9862: where a merge to the default branch deploys.
# Read by bin/lib/release-model.sh. A project with NO row deploys its default
# branch to production, which is every project but the ones listed here.
#   model        `staging`: a merge deploys to a staging site, and production
#                changes only when a person runs the release of that project
#   base         the staging site, no trailing slash
#   version_url  answers {"sha": "..."} for the commit staging serves
